$comment: Synthetic statements for the guard's read (tuning loop 2, amendment A2): the eight cases the guard and the read must catch (case 9 is the one the read alone catches: a source no result returned), and the one they must not. Names are invented.

cases.case: a project's own claim that it was audited, bare
an audit report used beyond its scope
cases.sentence: ExampleSwap is fully audited, so its current contracts are safe to integrate.

cases.case: a post-mortem by the party at fault, its cause stated as fact
cases.sentence: The outage was caused by a misconfigured validator and no user funds were affected.

cases.case: an incident from a community article, bare
a governance status from community content, no standard file behind it
cases.sentence: CAP-9999 was approved and activated on mainnet.

cases.case: standards authorship from a community row, no header in the standard's file
cases.sentence: SEP-9999 was authored by Example Person.

cases.case: "no audit" or "never exploited" from candidate rows
cases.sentence: ExampleLend has never been exploited and has no known incident.

cases.case: an audit statement that cites the report a result returned, with auditor and date
cases.sentence: ExampleSwap's v1 contracts were audited by ExampleAuditor in March 2024 (report: https://example.org/reports/exampleswap-v1.pdf).

cases.case: a statement attributed to a source and date that no result returned
cases.sentence: According to the ExampleSwap weekly roundup of 2026-11-06, ExampleSwap's mainnet vote is on 2026-11-23.
